study: Calendar-flow family on SPY and IWM: do the turn-of-month, quarter-end, pre-holiday, tax-loss-January and options-expiration windows earn more than other days, after costs?
registered_at: 2026-10-16 ~06:00 ET, before any data for these windows was computed.
origin: Operator 10/16; the family of the one effect that passed here (month-end SPY, +20.6 bp, t 3.7, 289 months; docs/studies/MONTH_END_REBAL_2026-10-01.md).
prior: MEDIUM for turn-of-month and pre-holiday (widely published, may be weaker since publication), LOW for options expiration, LOW-MEDIUM for tax-loss January in small caps (IWM).
data: Yahoo adjusted daily closes (yfinance, as month_end_rebal.py) for SPY 1993-02 and IWM 2000-06 to 2026-10-15; close-to-close returns; NYSE trading calendar from the data itself.

windows.TOM: turn of month: last trading day of the month through the 3rd trading day of the next (4 days)
windows.QE: quarter-end: last 2 trading days of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec
windows.PREHOL: the trading day before a market holiday (a weekday the market is closed)
windows.TAXJAN: IWM only: last 3 trading days of December through the 5th trading day of January
windows.OPEX: options-expiration week: Monday through the third Friday of the month

statistic: per window: mean daily return in-window minus mean daily return out-of-window (all other days), with a t from a two-sample test on daily returns and a year-clustered check; also the strategy return of holding the ETF only in-window, net of 2 bp per round trip (ETF spread at the close).
multiplicity: 9 window x ETF cells (5 windows on SPY, 4 on IWM incl. TAXJAN; TAXJAN not on SPY): pass t >= 2.6 (Bonferroni-ish for 9 cells at one-sided 0.05 ~ 2.5-2.6).
pass: a cell PASSES only if in BOTH halves: in-minus-out > 0 with t >= 2.6 AND the in-window strategy is positive after cost. Month-end alone (already passed) is reported, not re-graded.
information_only: combined calendar book (SPY in any passing window) - cumulative return, max drawdown, days invested
no_retuning: window definitions above are fixed; other lengths are a new prereg.
if_pass: add passing windows to the month-end pilot as score-only, then paper forward for >= 6 months of windows before any money.
if_fail: calendar effects beyond month-end are closed for this desk.
